outcome: Changes in PAP, WHO-FC, and NT-pro-BNP
cohort: Five women with PAH who delivered seven babies at a tertiary referral center between 2004 and 2020.
finding: Women with PAH with a low risk profile who were closely followed by a multidisciplinary team had favorable pregnancy courses and successful deliveries of healthy newborns.
mod_finding: All women gave birth to healthy babies by cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
